items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>Spain is in mourning following a train crash that killed at least 69 people. Funerals for some of the victims began on Friday. Spain's second major train collision this year has sparked debate over whether human error or failures in the rail network were to blame.

items.author: Associated Press
items.content:

items.title: LIVE: Mark Carney and Ursula von der Leyen hold a press conference
items.author: Associated Press
items.content: <article>Watch live as Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa deliver joint remarks in Montreal during an EU-Canada summit aimed at deepening ties. The proposal to give Canada EU "associate member" status faces resistance from some member states and the summit is putting Carney's vision for a new global order to the test.</article>
